proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10896 explicitly places Nepali haluko and Hindi halkā under the metathesized -kk extension, stored as 10896-5 *laghukk-. The survey halka forms fit this exact branch, with intra-IA transmission unresolved. Exact survey form halkā is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
